tldr: Moon in the 11th house routes emotional safety through community and future vision.
body: With the Moon in the 11th house, emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety move through friendship, community, networks, hopes, audiences, and the future. This makes how you belong, collaborate, and give your gifts to something larger than yourself a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs. Left unconscious, it can become mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs expressed through community and future vision.
challenge: mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area concentrated in community and future vision.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
